exclusion_reason: The static recompilation option is measured and reported on the bptk foundation compare surface and the dated feasibility note records the prior art, reusable foundation, and missing evidence, but no per-title pipeline exists, no representative title comparison has been measured, and the legal input path decision is open under BPTK-001.
promotion_trigger: Promote when an approved report compares a per-title static recompilation pipeline against the binary and source lane on effort, coverage, legal input, and measured performance for at least one representative title.
expected_failing_assertion: No credible per-title static-recompilation-to-WebAssembly pipeline has been demonstrated against the binary and source lane.
active_gate_evidence: The foundation compare surface carries the static_recompilation option with an honest unavailable signal and blocker, and doc/research-static-recomp.md records the deferral decision with its missing evidence.
procedure: Survey the static-recompilation prior art and its legal input requirement from current primary source.
Prototype the highest-risk step of a per-title machine-code to WebAssembly pipeline and compare cost and coverage to the binary and source lane.
pass_criterion: The report contains reproducible evidence rather than roadmap aspiration.
It recommends bounded adoption, continued research, or rejection of the lane without expanding a support claim.
